what: Inside the curtain covering the hero, a video is shown larger than the screen (120% of width) together with an airplane-window mask. It appears .5s after 1s and plays .2s later, and after 4s the mask shrinks over 3s power2.out to a 279px window while the frames on both sides shrink at the same rate to 1x and line up in a row. .6s later the video steps back to .5x over 3s and the whole curtain clears over 2s, leaving the same-position window (logo mark) in the hero below. For video, it starts after loadeddata is received

options.from: Initial mask width (% of window width), default 120 — phone 200
options.delay: Time from the curtain going up to the video appearing (seconds), default 1
options.hold: Seconds from playback until the mask starts to shrink, default 4
options.shrink: Scale the video recedes to, default .5
options.--fx-mask: Mask shape (image URL, via style) — default airplane window (279×333 rounded top and bottom)
options.--fx-lift: Distance to lift the window slot upward from the center (via style), default 45.89px — 34px on phone
options.[data-fx-part=mask]: Panel the mask is applied to (child of the curtain)
options.[data-fx-part=media]: Video or image inside the panel — first child of the panel if none
options.[data-fx-part=frame]: (If present) side window frames — shrink to 1× at the same ratio as the mask to become window lines

use:
…
→ Ends at fx:done
note: A part that makes people wait, so its lengths (delay · hold · dur · fade) are exposed as options — the original plays only on the first visit (sessionStorage). For returning visitors, do not attach it or shorten dur and hold. While the curtain lifts, shrinking the Hero logo mark below from k times to 1x with the same 3s power2.out recreates the original scene where the window remains as the mark

from.where: index.js .opening — the regional map video shrinks from 120vw → 279px inside an airplane-window mask, becomes the center window of three rows of windows, and remains as the hero logo symbol (original opening)
